title: powerops test --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops test --format json': one entry per flow test file, sorted by file, and a count per result. It holds no solution path, tenant value or time, so it is stable.

file.description: The test file, relative to the tests folder, with forward slashes.

flow.description: The flow's display name when it was found, else what the test file named.

solution.description: The unique name of the solution the flow was found in. Absent when no flow was found.

result.description: passed: the run finished and every assertion held. failed: an assertion did not hold, or the flow was not found or not unique, or the test is wrong. unmocked: the run needed a mock or a value the test did not give. unsupported: the flow uses something the simulator does not support. Anything but passed makes the exit code 1.

runStatus.description: The run's status. Present when the run finished.

message.description: Why the test did not reach its assertions (flow not found, unmocked action, unsupported function, ...). Absent when the run finished; look at the assertions then.

assertions.description: One entry per assertion of the test file, in order. Empty when the run did not finish.

index.description: Position in the test file's assertions, from 0.

description.description: What was checked, such as 'run status', 'status of Delete_Environment call 1' or 'inputs of Update_a_row at ["parameters","item/pops_name"]'.

expected.description: The test's 'equals' value (any JSON value, null included).

actual.description: The value found (any JSON value, null included). Present only for a failed assertion that found one; absent when there was none (the action did not run, the path was not found).

message.description: Why it failed when the values do not say, such as 'did not run', 'path not found' or 'call 1 of 2' (the call that differed).
